name: Kilnworks
pitch: An API that serves open-source models, on shared and dedicated GPUs.
culture: "No perf claim without a trace and a p99." Every PR that touches the hot path needs a before/after run. Weekly incident review, blameless but blunt.
team_blurb: Serving owns the path from the gateway to the GPUs: launch profiles, routing, autoscaling, and the benchmarks that gate every release.
